measurement_notes: All durations are internal native elapsed times; process startup and language bridges are excluded.
The host was not CPU-affinity-pinned or otherwise isolated. The 60 MP parallel and IIR diagnostic runs have substantial spread; pooled medians are descriptive, and paired batch ratios are retained.
Full grain favors Rust in every measured configuration and paired batch; these results characterize this implementation on macOS arm64.
platform: macOS 26.5.2 arm64, Apple M1 Pro, 10 CPU cores, 32 GiB RAM

build.rust_policy: opt-level=3, thin LTO, codegen-units=1, default target CPU, no fast math
build.goose_policy: Goose -O2 inlining, standalone generated C, clang -O3 -ffp-contract=off, default target CPU

results.restoration: fresh deep copy of immutable input immediately before each timer; warm cache, no explicit cache flush
results.timed_boundary: complete native operation; includes calibration, RNG init, scratch and required worker copies/assembly; excludes startup, fixture load, pools, restoration and checksum
